mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, it is a clear 66 degrees at Verona City Hall. The moon is in a waning crescent phase, and we expect an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall is reminding residents to subscribe to the Verona digital newsletter for updates on public works projects and city programs. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting on November 4 to discuss various development projects including the Ardent Glen plat.
Today you can catch Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia. Tomorrow, the town is busy with the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In a report from September 28, local officers responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto recklessly, resulting in multiple citations.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open but will be closing in 42 minutes at 10:00 PM, so there is still time to stop by for a treat.
